import json,zlib,hashlib,sys
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
r=Path('experiments/results/inten_geometric_prior')
sys.path.insert(0,str(r.resolve()))
from run_sequences import archived_frames
p=r/'paused_attempts/merge_requested_00'
meta=json.loads((p/'pause.json').read_text())
for name,digest in meta['files'].items():
 assert hashlib.sha256((p/name).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==digest,name
d=zlib.decompressobj(31)
data=d.decompress((p/'native.jsonl.gz.partial').read_bytes())
assert not d.eof and data.endswith(b'\n')
native=[json.loads(x) for x in data.splitlines()]
inputs=[json.loads(x) for x in (p/'inputs.jsonl').read_text().splitlines()]
poses={n:np.loadtxt(p/(n+'.txt')) for n in ('reference','candidate')}
o=Path('/workspace/localization-env/branch-cleanup-20261022/worktree/experiments/results/inten_facade_pca/sequences/00')
pins=json.loads((o/'inputs.json').read_text())['files']
cmd=json.loads((p/'native_command.json').read_text())
assert cmd['exit_code'] is None
assert hashlib.sha256((o/'inputs.json').read_bytes()).hexdigest()==cmd['input_manifest_sha256']
assert cmd['trace_shards']=={f.name:hashlib.sha256(f.read_bytes()).hexdigest() for f in sorted((o/'candidate/trace.jsonl.parts').glob('*.gz'))}
count=meta['complete_input_records_saved']
assert len(native)==len(inputs)==count
assert all(len(v)==count for v in poses.values())
ref=archived_frames(o/'candidate/trace.jsonl.parts')
maximum=0.0
for i,(row,inp) in enumerate(zip(native,inputs)):
 old=next(ref)
 assert row['frame']==inp['frame']==old['input_index']==i
 assert inp['sha256']==pins[f'{i:06d}.bin']['sha256'] and inp['bytes']==pins[f'{i:06d}.bin']['bytes']
 error=float(np.max(np.abs(np.array(row['reference']['pose'])-np.array(old['pose']))))
 assert error==inp['baseline_max_abs_error'] and error<=1e-8
 maximum=max(maximum,error)
 for n in poses:
  expected=np.array(row[n]['pose']).reshape(4,4)[:3].flatten()
  assert np.isfinite(expected).all() and np.array_equal(expected,poses[n][i])
summary={'paused_prefix_frames_verified':count,'maximum_baseline_matrix_error':maximum,'input_hashes_order_and_pose_exports_valid':True,'gzip_stream_finalized':False,'native_exit_code':None,'full_sequence_accuracy_claim':False}
(p/'prefix_audit.json').write_text(json.dumps(summary,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps(summary))
